essence: The yantra's power immediately brings suffering upon an enemy.
A diagram filled beneath the elephant tree causes separation of sons and wives.
Another Tvaritā yantra is described as having eight cells with upper and lower lips.
Afterward, one should certainly envelop that diagram with the syllables of the Yama mantra.
After covering the yantra with the Kālī mantra, one should envelop it on the outside.
